title: Stray
description: Stray follows a lost cat trying to escape a decaying cybercity. Explore rooftops and alleys, interact with droids, solve environmental puzzles, avoid hostile creatures, and work with the small drone B-12. Nintendo lists the Switch version as compatible with Switch 2, while a separate native Switch 2 version also exists.
